verdict.line: You lose if you let Sett walk you into Facebreaker range and tank E-Q trades at close quarters; you win by poking from max range and denying his all-in windows with Q.

brief.thesis: This matchup is EVEN in overall win rate (51.1% over 94 games) but Sett holds the solo-kill edge, because Facebreaker (E) punishes any Teemo who gets caught between minions or stands still too long. Teemo's entire job is to deal damage from 680 range while never entering Sett's 490-range E or 25000-range W threat zone once Grit is full.

theirWindow.when: Grit bar full and E off cooldown
theirWindow.what: If Sett has stacked enough Grit for a strong Haymaker shield and his E (Facebreaker, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown) is up, he can shield through your poke and punish an approach or a bad position between minions. Back off and reset spacing rather than trading auto-for-auto here.

yourWindow.what: Once Facebreaker is spent, Sett has no stun/slow pull to close distance safely. Walk up, land Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) to blind him through his own trade, then kite with E (Toxic Shot) autos while W (Move Quick) keeps you faster than he can chase.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Doran's Ring is run in 74.8% of games (50.5% win rate over 95 games) because the extra sustain and mana let you spam Q to blind Sett out of every short trade.

boots.why: Picked in 58.9% of games (49.3% win rate over 73 games) — the flat movement speed keeps you a step ahead of Sett's Q (Knuckle Down) chase speed so he can never close the gap to land Facebreaker.

core.why: First item in the most common build path (64.7% win rate over 34 games), gives on-hit damage and a slow proc to peel away after poke
Scales your sustained poison damage from E (Toxic Shot) and R (Noxious Trap) against Sett's naturally high HP pool
Closes out the top build path (46% pick rate) and amplifies your burst window once you land a blind-into-full-combo

situational.when: sett builds early armor and you need to punch through it instead of outrunning him
he's building any magic resist and you need the bonus damage to squishier health thresholds
you're ahead and want to snowball attack speed to shred him faster in extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards your poke pattern — three autos (aided by E's Toxic Shot) mark Sett for bonus damage, which matters since you win by outdamaging him at range rather than all-in burst.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 88% of games (50.9% win rate) — Ignite punishes Sett's passive Pit Grit healing from missing HP, and Flash lets you dodge Facebreaker's pull entirely when he lines it up.

playing.title: Never clump with minions
playing.detail: Facebreaker (E, 490 range) only stuns if Sett catches enemies on opposite sides of him — staying on one side of the wave removes the stun and leaves only a slow, which you can walk off.

playing.title: Blind before he swings
playing.detail: Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) negates his empowered Knuckle Down autos entirely since a blinded Sett misses basic attacks — use it the instant he commits to a trade.

playing.title: Track his Grit bar visually
playing.detail: Sett's W (Haymaker) has no fixed cooldown gate beyond 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s but needs stored Grit to be worth casting — if his Grit bar looks empty from recent damage taken, his all-in has far less shield and burst.

playing.title: Lay traps on his approach lines
playing.detail: R (Noxious Trap, 1s cooldown, 230 range) is nearly spammable — seed the brush and choke points he must walk through to reach you, since the slow alone buys enough time to kite with E autos.

playing.title: Camo-reset after every poke string
playing.detail: Standing still briefly after a trade triggers Camouflage, and the Attack Speed burst from Element of Surprise on breaking invisibility adds a free damage spike to your next engage.

playing.title: Don't autoattack through his passive punches
playing.detail: Sett's right punch is slightly stronger — if you're forced into prolonged auto trades you're feeding his Pit Grit sustain for free, so disengage and poke from range instead.

playing.title: Use W to escape, not to flex closer
playing.detail: Move Quick's bonus speed is only active until he or a turret strikes you — use the window purely to create distance after landing poke, not to greed extra autos.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample-size figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the ability mechanics, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of Facebreaker (E)! Manage your distance well keeping Facebreaker (E) in mind while dealing damage!
